name: Mercure Prishtina City
desc: Mercure Prishtina City is a 4.5 star hotel located in the heart the capital city of Kosovo, offering elegant and spacious rooms with all necessary amenities. It features an Italian restaurant, a bar, 24 hour front desk, and fitness center.
